---
title: ""
page-layout: full
include-in-header:
  text: |
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Syne:wght@400;600;700;800&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
    <link href="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.5.0/css/all.min.css" rel="stylesheet"/>
    <style>
      .about-hero { padding:4rem 2rem 3rem; max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; }
      .ah-inner { display:flex; gap:3rem; align-items:flex-start; }
      .ah-left { flex-shrink:0; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:1.2rem; }
      .avatar-ring { width:160px; height:160px; border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366F1,#F97316); padding:3px; box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(99,102,241,0.25); }
      .avatar-inner { width:100%; height:100%; border-radius:50%; background:#EEF2FF; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; overflow:hidden; }
      .avatar-inner i { font-size:3.5rem; color:#6366F1; opacity:0.4; }
      .social-stack { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:0.5rem; width:100%; }
      .slink { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.6rem; font-size:0.8rem; color:#64748B; text-decoration:none; padding:6px 12px; border-radius:8px; transition:all 0.2s; font-weight:500; white-space:nowrap; }
      .slink i { width:14px; text-align:center; color:#6366F1; }
      .slink:hover { background:#EEF2FF; color:#6366F1; }
      .ah-right { flex:1; }
      .ah-right h1 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:2.2rem; font-weight:800; letter-spacing:-0.03em; margin-bottom:0.2rem; }
      .ah-title { font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; color:#6366F1; margin-bottom:0.15rem; }
      .ah-affil { font-size:0.88rem; color:#94A3B8; font-weight:500; margin-bottom:1.2rem; }
      .ah-affil i { color:#F97316; margin-right:0.3rem; font-size:0.8rem; }
      .ah-bio { font-size:0.95rem; color:#475569; line-height:1.8; }
      .ah-bio p+p { margin-top:0.8rem; }
      .cv-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; margin-top:1.5rem; padding:0.6rem 1.5rem; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366F1,#818CF8); color:#fff; border-radius:999px; text-decoration:none; font-size:0.85rem; font-weight:700; box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(99,102,241,0.35); transition:all 0.25s; }
      .cv-btn:hover { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(99,102,241,0.4); color:#fff; text-decoration:none; }
      .pw { max-width:900px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 2rem 4rem; }
      .sec-block { margin-bottom:2.5rem; }
      .sec-block-title { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.8rem; margin-bottom:1.3rem; padding-bottom:0.8rem; border-bottom:2px solid #F1F5F9; }
      .sec-block-title h2 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:700; margin:0; }
      .sec-block-icon { width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:10px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:0.9rem; flex-shrink:0; }
      .tl { position:relative; padding-left:2rem; }
      .tl::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:8px; top:8px; bottom:8px; width:2px; background:linear-gradient(to bottom,#6366F1 0%,#E2E8F0 100%); border-radius:2px; }
      .tl-item { position:relative; margin-bottom:1.6rem; }
      .tl-dot { position:absolute; left:-2rem; top:5px; width:16px; height:16px; border-radius:50%; border:3px solid #fff; background:#6366F1; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #6366F1; }
      .tl-dot-cur { background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366F1,#F97316); box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #6366F1; animation:glow 2s infinite; }
      @keyframes glow { 0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #6366F1} 50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(99,102,241,0.3)} }
      .tl-dot-muted { background:#CBD5E1; box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #CBD5E1; }
      .tl-period { font-size:0.75rem; color:#94A3B8; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.2rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:0.5rem; }
      .badge-now { font-size:0.65rem; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#6366F1,#818CF8); color:#fff; padding:2px 8px; border-radius:999px; font-weight:700; }
      .tl-role { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:0.98rem; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:0.15rem; }
      .tl-place { font-size:0.85rem; color:#94A3B8; font-weight:500; margin-bottom:0.3rem; }
      .tl-place i { font-size:0.75rem; margin-right:0.2rem; color:#F97316; }
      .tl-desc { font-size:0.85rem; color:#64748B; line-height:1.65; }
      .research-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:1rem; }
      .rcard { background:#fff; border:1.5px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:14px; padding:1.1rem 1.3rem; display:flex; gap:0.9rem; align-items:flex-start; transition:all 0.3s; }
      .rcard:hover { border-color:#6366F1; box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(99,102,241,0.1); transform:translateY(-3px); }
      .rcard-icon { width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:10px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-size:1rem; flex-shrink:0; }
      .rcard h4 { font-family:'Syne',sans-serif; font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:700; margin-bottom:0.25rem; line-height:1.3; }
      .rcard p { font-size:0.8rem; color:#94A3B8; line-height:1.55; margin:0; }
      .chips-wrap { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:0.6rem; }
      .skill-chip { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:0.35rem; padding:6px 14px; background:#fff; border:1.5px solid #E2E8F0; border-radius:999px; font-size:0.8rem; font-weight:600; color:#334155; transition:all 0.2s; }
      .skill-chip i { font-size:0.78rem; color:#6366F1; }
      .skill-chip:hover { border-color:#6366F1; color:#6366F1; background:#EEF2FF; }
      @media(max-width:640px){ .ah-inner{flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;} .social-stack{align-items:center;} .research-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;} }
    </style>
---
